description: code/database/pipeline replication (both 'replication of X' and 'X replication' forms), not psychological. #147: the object list no longer carries model/method/data/dataset. Those four words are how a computational reproduction describes itself — 'A Replication and Analysis of Tiebout Competition Using an Agent-Based Computational Model', 'Replicating MOOC predictive models at scale' — and the pattern was killing them terminally. Narrowed to the TO2_both_tight variant of analysis/stage_b_eval/exclusion_candidates.csv (both sides of the pattern, so 'model replication' and 'replication of the model' go together): +18 gold positives for 3.9 extra rows per million (~1,990 across the 510M-row snapshot), 0 gold negatives, and 3 of the 5 indexed reproductions the pipeline loses are recovered (reproduction_coverage_report.md). The surviving objects are the storage/distributed-systems sense, which is the pattern's real referent: the matched-span census over 5.6M rows found 'data replication' 36 times, 'database replication' 7 and 'model replication' 3. NOTE: this spec is also read by filter/phrase_detection.py::_load_exclusion_regexes(), so the narrowing changes Stage 1 admission as well as engine routing — intended, and it moves stage_b_fingerprint(). Loaded back into keyword_verdict() as pattern id TECHNICAL_OBJECT (filter/phrase_detection.py).

measured.rationale: 'replication of the code/pipeline/database' names a technical artifact, not a study. Rows that are genuine computational reproductions carry a phrase AND a cite and are readmitted by exclusion-rescue (#44) at precedence 650.

measured.sample: 5.6M OpenAlex snapshot rows (22 parquet partitions of the 2,446-file manifest, 64,118 Stage A survivors, complete harvest of the 3,785 exclusion-firing survivors) scored against the 7,505-paper override_positives.json gold corpus and the 1,333-paper gold-negative set; branch analysis/stage-b-eval, #144 evidence pass. Provenance caveat (#151): 4,681 of the 7,505 gold positives (62%) are `allrep_llm` — the old pipeline's own LLM verdicts, never human-confirmed — so the gold-recall figure is an upper bound, and only the 38% curated share (entry_sheet, flora_db) is human evidence.
measured.rationale: #147 narrowing (TO2_both_tight): dropping model/method/data/dataset from both sides recovers 18 gold positives, admits 0 additional gold negatives, and costs 3.9 rows per million scanned (0.17% of admitted volume, ~1,990 rows over the full snapshot). Influx sampled as CS storage-replication papers ('A Strategy for Data Replication in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks'), which enter as screen_cheap rather than being admitted. The residual pattern keeps its trusted rationale above; this entry measures what the narrowing costs.
